observation: Fresh main silently swallowed malformed package.json during automatic validation discovery. In a mixed-language workspace that could omit JavaScript validation commands while still running and potentially passing another language's validators, weakening the hard acceptance boundary without surfacing the broken manifest.
changes: Make automatic package.json discovery fail explicitly with INVALID_PACKAGE_JSON instead of silently omitting package validation.
Convert discovery failure into a structured failed acceptance receipt with hardGate VALIDATION_DISCOVERY_FAILED.
Preserve explicitly supplied validation commands so callers that intentionally bypass discovery keep their existing behavior.

verification.pre_fix_source_contract_replay: EXPECTED FAIL: malformed package.json was caught and ignored, after which pyproject.toml or other evidence could continue alone.
verification.post_fix_source_contract_replay: PASS: automatic discovery fails closed before validators run; explicit commands remain explicit.
verification.focused_regression_contract: tests/acceptance-package-manifest-parse-integrity.test.mjs covers malformed-manifest discovery failure and explicit-command compatibility.

truth_boundary: This cycle only closes silent parse failure in automatic package validation discovery. It does not require every repository to have package.json and does not redefine user-supplied validation commands.
